candidate.answerReason: The product (-2/5)(-5/2) equals 1, so -5/2 is the reciprocal.

methods.label: Use the reciprocal definition
methods.explanation: Two numbers whose product is 1 are reciprocals of each other. Since \((-2/5)\times(-5/2)=1\), the reciprocal is \(-5/2\) (a reciprocal has the same sign as the original number).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 reciprocal definition and signed rational multiplication.
